Explicit parity-dependent X_jk=(N+1−k)[j/κ+κ(j−1)/Ω²] for even gap, −i(N+1−k)/Ω for odd gap (j<=k), plus conjugate extension; affine second differences and right boundary s_(N+1)=0 establish entrywise commutator identity. This identifies mean for arbitrary density matrices. Diagonal E_j τ=(N+1−j)(j/κ+κ(j−1)/Ω²), strictly convex in κ for j>=2, gives κ_opt=Ω sqrt(j/(j−1)) independent of N and minimum 2(N+1−j)sqrt(j(j−1))/Ω. For j=1 mean N/κ monotone. Independent Python numpy recomputation of Lyapunov residual for N=2..8 and multiple positive Ω,κ passed; all-N is from exact recurrence.
